Pac Performance (AU) sells a reproduction 'Gen1 series 2/3 rear beaver tail light panel' at AU$825 inc GST (2026-09-26); mazda.oempartsonline.com lists FA54-70-750 as a 1985 RX-7 rear body panel, whether it supersedes FA01-70-750C is not verified: check.
